content: Service role review: key must never be NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefixed, never imported from a client component, isolated in a separate admin client module, used only in route handlers/server actions/edge functions. Review checklist: naming, import graph reachability from client bundles, per-callsite justification that RLS bypass is required, rotation procedure. Common failure: service client used for convenience in a user-facing route, silently removing all tenant isolation.
